caveats: Research only: no orders, broker connectivity, live trading, or vendor downloads.
Prepared history may contain ex-post price repairs; preparation is separate from strict experiment ingestion and is not point-in-time.
The equity proxy (^NSEI) is an index, not directly tradable; the bond leg is a liquid/cash proxy, not a duration hedge.
Costs are assumed flat one-way bps, not calibrated execution estimates; taxes, impact and capacity are not established.
Evaluation is chronological attribution of a continuous run, not independent refitting or an untouched holdout.
Descriptive comparisons and HMM probabilities do not establish significance, causal explanations, or future performance.
HMM state names are training-derived interpretations; posterior uncertainty is conditional on the fitted model, not calibrated forecast confidence.
timestamp_convention: Each row is a close-to-close return date t (Asia/Kolkata trading date, tz-naive). gross_return(t) is earned by holdings in place before close t; transaction_cost(t) is paid at close t on the trade that fills at close t; a target signalled at close t (data through t) fills at close t+1 and first earns t+1 -> t+2.
cost_units: Fraction of portfolio wealth paid at the fill close; costs are one-way bps per unit of traded weight.
turnover_units: One-way turnover 0.5 * sum(|w_target - w_pre_trade|) per fill; the initial allocation from cash counts as sum(|w_target|) = 1.0.
drawdown_units: Signed fraction below high-water mark including starting wealth 1; <=0.
probability_source: Reference RegimeShift HMM, last known signal at each close; not the executed target's signal necessarily.
hmm_fixed_explanation: Reference HMM signal regime under the same deterministic configuration; not separately instrumented ablation diagnostics.

engine_metadata.execution_timing: Signal at close t from data through t; fill and cost at close t+1 after the t-to-t+1 return accrues on prior holdings; new target first earns t+1-to-t+2.
engine_metadata.tradability_label: Index-level allocation simulation: equity uses ^NSEI, which is a signal/benchmark series and not a guaranteed executable fill.
engine_metadata.market_impact_and_capacity: Not modeled because executable volume/ADV data is not included.
